note: What Insert puts on a slide besides text and shapes. A table is an object of kind table whose cells are rows of texts, the first row its header, the others banded in its tint (an accent of the theme): Insert > Table opens a grid of sizes, a double click on a cell edits it, and Tab and Shift+Tab go to the next and the previous cell (Tab in the last one adds a row). A picture is an object of kind picture whose src is the PNG or JPEG the person chose, held in the deck as a data URI, so the saved deck carries it.

tableGrid.note: Insert > Table: a grid of sizes; the pointer picks one, a click puts that table on the slide.

slideTable.note: A table object's cells, in a box w by h: the header row in its tint, the rows banded; while a cell is edited, an editor over it, the same one from cell to cell.

children.bind: {{'state.deck.slides[' + state.current + '].objects[' + indexOf(map(computed.objects, it.id), o.id) + '].cells[' + r + '][' + c + ']'}}
children.label: {{'Row ' + (r + 1) + ', column ' + (c + 1)}}

slidePicture.note: A picture object: its image, filling its box w by h.

with.object: {{ {kind: 'table', x: 80, y: 270 - min(rows * 40, 440) / 2, w: 800, h: min(rows * 40, 440), tint: 'accent1', cells: map(range(rows), map(range(cols), ''))} }}

editCell.note: with: id, r, c: the table and the cell edited, in an editor over it, until Escape or a click elsewhere

editObject.note: with: id, left, top, width, height: a double click on an object; a table edits the cell under the pointer, other objects their text

with.r: {{clamp(floor(top / max(height, 1) * length(find(computed.objects, it.id == id).cells)), 0, length(find(computed.objects, it.id == id).cells) - 1)}}
with.c: {{clamp(floor(left / max(width, 1) * length(find(computed.objects, it.id == id).cells[0])), 0, length(find(computed.objects, it.id == id).cells[0]) - 1)}}

nextCell.note: with: by: Tab (1) goes to the next cell, Shift+Tab (-1) to the one before; Tab in the last cell adds a row

nextCell.if: {{max(state.cell[0] * length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells[0]) + state.cell[1] + by, 0) >= length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells) * length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells[0])}}

then.to: {{map(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing ? merge(it, { cells: concat(it.cells, [map(it.cells[0], '')]), h: it.h + it.h / length(it.cells) }) : it)}}

nextCell.to: {{[floor(max(state.cell[0] * length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells[0]) + state.cell[1] + by, 0) / length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells[0])), max(state.cell[0] * length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells[0]) + state.cell[1] + by, 0) % length(find(computed.objects, it.id == state.editing).cells[0])]}}

setTableTint.note: with: tint: the selected tables take an accent of the theme

then.to: {{map(computed.objects, contains(state.board.selection, it.id) && it.kind == 'table' ? merge(it, { tint: tint }) : it)}}

placePicture.note: with: result, k: the picture's size scaled by k (400 by 300 when the file doesn't say), in the middle of the slide

with.object: {{ {kind: 'picture', w: (result.width ?? 0) > 0 ? round(result.width * k) : 400, h: (result.height ?? 0) > 0 ? round(result.height * k) : 300, x: 480 - ((result.width ?? 0) > 0 ? round(result.width * k) : 400) / 2, y: 270 - ((result.height ?? 0) > 0 ? round(result.height * k) : 300) / 2, src: state.picture, alt: result.name} }}

pictureOpened.note: with: result: the picture just opened goes in the middle of the slide, at most 640 by 400, and is selected
